title: Fix octopus test
body:
Fix test failure with octopus.

I get this failure even if I try to run the octopus tutorials, so that's pretty strange.  Maybe some optional library (like spglib) is missing when compiling, I wouldn't know.

Somehow LatticeVectors/LSize versus number of periodic directions were set in a way that was liable to cause hubbub.  This MR also attempts to fix that.

Also enable ruff on the Octopus calculator and IO code.
